instruction.name: xvffintl.d.w
instruction.description: Convert signed 32-bit integer elements in lower part of every 128-bit vector of `a` to double precision floating point numbers.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 5.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvffintl.d.w $xr0, $xr8; xvffintl.d.w $xr1, $xr9; xvffintl.d.w $xr2, $xr10; xvffintl.d.w $xr3, $xr11; xvffintl.d.w $xr4, $xr12; xvffintl.d.w $xr5, $xr13; xvffintl.d.w $xr6, $xr14; xvffintl.d.w $xr7, $xr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4' --asm 'xvffintl.d.w $xr0, $xr8; xvffintl.d.w $xr1, $xr9; xvffintl.d.w $xr2, $xr10; xvffintl.d.w $xr3, $xr11; xvffintl.d.w $xr4, $xr12; xvffintl.d.w $xr5, $xr13; xvffintl.d.w $xr6, $xr14; xvffintl.d.w $xr7, $xr15'
